description: Prebuilt WIT v1 handler component frozen for 1.0 ABI compatibility testing. CI must NOT rebuild this fixture from the current WIT source on every run; the component is treated as an immutable witness that the runtime continues to load historical v1 handlers throughout the 1.x cycle.

build.buildCommand: cargo build --release --target wasm32-unknown-unknown && wasm-tools component new target/wasm32-unknown-unknown/release/echo-handler.wasm -o handler-v1-component.wasm

freezePolicy: This fixture is committed to the repository and must not be rebuilt by CI.
The current runtime must continue to load this fixture for the entire 1.x cycle.
If the runtime fails to load this fixture, the change is a breaking WIT ABI change and requires a new rill:handler@2.x package plus a HANDLER_API_VERSION bump.
Additive WIT changes within v1 must not break loading this fixture.
The fixture's SHA-256 is verified by the wit_v1_component test before loading.
